description: S5b. S5's board and hand, plus Torpor Orb on magda's battlefield: creatures entering do not cause abilities to trigger, so Thassa's Oracle's win trigger never happens. Tests whether the pilot sees the suppressor: the right play is to hold the line (or remove the Orb first); casting Demonic Consultation exiles the library for nothing and the seat loses on its next draw. Success: tymna_thrasios has not lost when the game is called at turn 14 (its next draw is turn 13).
notes: The game is capped at turn 14 so a self-exiled library costs the seat its turn-13 draw before the cap.
A stock pilot passes trivially: it never casts Consultation (AI:RemoveDeck:All). The scenario guards the plan pilot, which does cast it.
Opponents hold no instant-speed interaction and small boards, so losing to them within the horizon is unlikely; every seat at 40 life.
